correctness.rationale: Recomputed the whole finite domain independently (python3 /tmp/opencode/factorial_review_exhaust.py {1..12}). Enumerated divisors by integer factor pairs up to the square root. Maintained at-most-k reachability directly, initialized with zero in every layer, and updated layers downward with the union of the old layer and the old next-lower layer shifted by the current divisor. This encodes exactly the two choices to omit or include that divisor once. Positive summands justify discarding sums above N. The first full layer and the complement size in the preceding layer reproduced all twelve rows, including the n=1 boundary; zero is always covered. At 12!, all 792 divisors were processed and all 479001601 positions were covered at layer 8. The layer-7 complement was read in ascending order and matched EXTREMAL_TARGETS.json entry by entry. Its 175 targets are odd and have endpoints 475785157 and 479001547. The frozen C++ cross-check only treats n=8 through 11 and is not needed for that final comparison. No result for n≥13 follows.
